Definition: there is or are (or any other form of the verb to be, as may suit the connection)
BiblicalUsage: yêsh is the word for there is, there are. In Genesis 18:24, Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city, and it appears again in Exodus 17:7.
TheologicalSignificance: Abraham asks whether fifty righteous are there, and I believe yêsh turns on the plain fact of God's people in a place.
